CARS & GROUP TRANSPORT

Tirupati car rentals.

Arrange a car with a driver or ask for a self-drive rental. Share your dates and travel needs so the owner can confirm the available options.

What types of cars do you have?

Our vehicle choices are Maruti S-Cross, Innova Crysta, Innova, Ertiga, Tempo Traveller, Toyota Etios and Swift Dzire. Driver-operated and self-drive car rentals are also available. Share your date, group size and luggage needs on WhatsApp so the owner can confirm the suitable vehicle, seating and rental terms.

Cars with a driver

Ask about Tirupati car travel, Tirumala transport, airport or railway station pickup, local visits and outstation travel. Share the route, pickup and drop-off points, date and number of travellers.

Self-drive car rentals

Self-drive car options are also available. Confirm the car, rental period, pickup and return arrangements, and rental terms directly with the owner before booking. This website does not publish a fixed rental rate or guarantee vehicle availability.

Car with a driver or self-drive?

Car with a driver
Share the temple route or pickup and drop points, travel dates, passenger count and bags. Ask which car model is available and how the trip is charged.
Self-drive car
Share pickup and return dates and times. Ask about the driving licence and ID requirements, deposit, fuel policy, distance limit, extra-distance charges, late return and damage terms.
A family or larger group
Ask about a sedan, SUV, Tempo Traveller, mini bus or bus. Confirm passenger seats separately from the driver seat, luggage space and whether the same vehicle can cover every stop.

Specific models, seating, rental limits and charges vary with the confirmed arrangement. Ask the owner for these details in writing before booking; this checklist does not set rental terms.
